title: Emergency Medication Kits
rule_summary: Massachusetts long-term-care facilities may maintain approved emergency medication kits with separate Schedule II-V analgesic and sedative/anticonvulsant category limits tied to licensed bed capacity, single-dose tamper-evident packaging, accountability controls, and controlled Schedule VI emergency-stock safeguards.
exam_relevance: Tests a distinct pharmacist decision path using current official authority rather than rote trivia.
